list_child.name: listwomaint
list_child.desc: This tool pulls every lift maintenance work order currently on the resort's maintenance board. Use it when the lift supervisor plans repair crews for the day ahead.

decoys.name: listwoinsp
decoys.desc: This tool pulls every lift maintenance work order currently on the state tramway inspection board. Use it when the lift supervisor prepares for an inspector's visit.

decoys.name: listwosummer
decoys.desc: This tool pulls every lift maintenance work order currently on the resort's summer projects board. Use it when the lift supervisor plans off-season overhauls.

decoys.name: listwowarranty
decoys.desc: This tool pulls every lift maintenance work order currently on the manufacturer's warranty board. Use it when the lift supervisor files claims with the lift maker.

get_child.name: getworecord
get_child.desc: This tool fetches the full record of a single lift maintenance work order using its id. It is used when one specific work order needs to be inspected in detail.

decoys.name: getwoparts
decoys.desc: This tool fetches the parts list of a single lift maintenance work order using its id. It is used when one specific work order's components need checking against stock.

decoys.name: getwolog
decoys.desc: This tool fetches the ropeway log entries of a single lift maintenance work order using its id. It is used when one specific work order's daily checks need to be reviewed.

decoys.name: getwosignoff
decoys.desc: This tool fetches the inspector sign-off of a single lift maintenance work order using its id. It is used when one specific work order's approval needs to be verified.

list_parent.name: listctrroster
list_parent.desc: This tool lists every maintenance contractor currently on the resort's approved vendor roster. Use it to see the firms available for assignment to lift repairs.

decoys.name: listctrbid
decoys.desc: This tool lists every maintenance contractor currently on the resort's summer bid list. Use it to see the firms invited to quote on off-season projects.

decoys.name: listctrsafety
decoys.desc: This tool lists every maintenance contractor currently on the resort's safety induction register. Use it to see the firms cleared to work on the mountain.

decoys.name: listctrap
decoys.desc: This tool lists every maintenance contractor currently on the resort's accounts payable ledger. Use it to see the firms the resort pays for lift work.

get_parent.name: getctrrecord
get_parent.desc: This tool fetches the profile of a single maintenance contractor by id, returning their assignment history. It should be used when details on one specific contractor are required.

decoys.name: getctrinsurance
decoys.desc: This tool fetches the insurance certificate of a single maintenance contractor by id, returning their cover limits. It should be used when proof of cover for one contractor is required.

decoys.name: getctrcerts
decoys.desc: This tool fetches the tramway certifications of a single maintenance contractor by id, returning their technicians' licences. It should be used when one contractor's qualifications are required.

decoys.name: getctrrates
decoys.desc: This tool fetches the rate card of a single maintenance contractor by id, returning their hourly and callout charges. It should be used when pricing for one specific contractor is required.

delete_child.name: killwo
delete_child.desc: This tool permanently deletes a lift maintenance work order from the resort's system and the action cannot be undone once it is submitted. Use it when a work order was created in error or is being fully superseded.

decoys.name: voidparts
decoys.desc: This tool permanently voids the parts order raised for a lift maintenance work order and the action cannot be undone once it is submitted. Use it when a supplier order was raised in error.

decoys.name: purgelog
decoys.desc: This tool permanently purges the ropeway log entries of a lift maintenance work order and the action cannot be undone once it is submitted. Use it when test entries were logged against the wrong lift.

decoys.name: revokesignoff
decoys.desc: This tool permanently revokes the inspector sign-off on a lift maintenance work order and the action cannot be undone once it is submitted. Use it when an approval was granted on faulty test results.

set_enum.name: setwophase
set_enum.desc: This tool changes the phase of a lift maintenance work order between queued, in progress, and completed, moving it through the resort's repair workflow. Use it whenever a work order's standing needs to be updated to reflect real progress.

decoys.name: setwotarget
decoys.desc: This tool sets the target phase of a lift maintenance work order between queued, in progress, and completed, for the date the lift must reopen. Use it whenever planners need to record where a job should stand by opening day.

decoys.name: setwoboard
decoys.desc: This tool changes the phase shown for a lift maintenance work order on the guest lift status board, between queued, in progress, and completed. Use it whenever skiers need to see how a lift repair is going.

decoys.name: setwoalert
decoys.desc: This tool sets the phase at which a lift maintenance work order alerts ski patrol, between queued, in progress, and completed. Use it whenever patrol needs a warning before a lift reopens to the public.

set_bool.name: flagpriority
set_bool.desc: This tool marks a lift maintenance work order as a priority repair, pushing it above routine work on the resort's board. Use it when a lift fault poses a safety or opening-day risk.

decoys.name: flaglockout
decoys.desc: This tool marks a lift maintenance work order as a lockout job, requiring the lift's power to be isolated before crews start. Use it when a repair involves the drive or bullwheel.

decoys.name: flagnight
decoys.desc: This tool marks a lift maintenance work order as a night-shift job, pushing it to after the lifts close for the day. Use it when a repair would disrupt skiers during operating hours.

decoys.name: flagrope
decoys.desc: This tool marks a lift maintenance work order as rope work, requiring a certified splicer on the crew. Use it when a repair touches the haul rope or its splices.

set_ref.name: movewo
set_ref.desc: This tool reassigns a lift maintenance work order from its current contractor to a different one entirely, updating who is responsible for the repair. Use it when a contractor drops a job or a better-suited firm becomes available.

decoys.name: billwo
decoys.desc: This tool bills a lift maintenance work order to a different contractor entirely, updating who pays for the repair. Use it when damage was caused by another firm's crew or equipment on the lift.

decoys.name: inspectwo
decoys.desc: This tool sends a lift maintenance work order to a different contractor for independent inspection, updating who signs off the repair. Use it when a second firm must verify the work before reopening.

decoys.name: partswo
decoys.desc: This tool routes the parts order for a lift maintenance work order to a different contractor entirely, updating who supplies the components. Use it when the usual supplier is out of stock or too slow.

send.name: pingctr
send.desc: This tool sends a message to a maintenance contractor, either about a specific work order or as a direct note. Use it to keep contractors informed of new assignments or urgent status changes.

decoys.name: radioctr
decoys.desc: This tool radios a maintenance contractor's crew on the mountain channel, either about a specific work order or as a direct call. Use it to reach crews working on a lift tower in real time.
child_verbs: get the contractor behind {obj} on the radio

decoys.name: remitctr
decoys.desc: This tool sends a payment remittance to a maintenance contractor, either for a specific work order or as a lump sum. Use it to settle contractor invoices once repairs are signed off.
child_verbs: send the contractor behind {obj} their remittance

decoys.name: calloutctr
decoys.desc: This tool sends an emergency callout to a maintenance contractor, either about a specific work order or as a general standby. Use it to bring a crew up the mountain outside normal hours.
child_verbs: send an emergency callout to the contractor behind {obj}

create.name: createwo
create.desc: This tool creates a new lift maintenance work order for a contractor, with an optional lift name and starting phase. Use it when a new fault or scheduled job needs to go on the board.

decoys.name: createinsp
decoys.desc: This tool creates a new tramway inspection for a contractor, with an optional lift name and starting phase. Use it when a lift is due for its periodic safety check.

decoys.name: createquote
decoys.desc: This tool creates a new repair quote request for a contractor, with an optional lift name and starting phase. Use it when the resort wants a price before committing to a job.

decoys.name: createpermit
decoys.desc: This tool creates a new hot work permit for a contractor, with an optional lift name and starting phase. Use it when welding or cutting is planned near a lift.

list_notes.name: listwonotes
list_notes.desc: This tool returns the notes attached to a single lift maintenance work order. It includes every remark crews and supervisors have logged against that job.

decoys.name: listwoparts
decoys.desc: This tool returns the parts requests attached to a single lift maintenance work order. It includes every component crews have asked stores to issue for that job.

decoys.name: listwotests
decoys.desc: This tool returns the load test results attached to a single lift maintenance work order. It includes every test run crews have recorded on that job.

decoys.name: listwopermits
decoys.desc: This tool returns the work permits attached to a single lift maintenance work order. It includes every lockout and hot work permit issued for that job.

add_note.name: addwonote
add_note.desc: This tool attaches a new note to a lift maintenance work order. It is used to record remarks from the crew, with an optional title.

decoys.name: addwopart
decoys.desc: This tool attaches a new parts request to a lift maintenance work order. It is used to ask stores for components, with an optional title.

decoys.name: addwotest
decoys.desc: This tool attaches a new load test result to a lift maintenance work order. It is used to record a test run by the crew, with an optional title.

decoys.name: addwopermit
decoys.desc: This tool attaches a new work permit to a lift maintenance work order. It is used to record a lockout or hot work approval, with an optional title.

update_note.name: editwonote
update_note.desc: This tool changes the text, and optionally the title, of an existing note on a lift maintenance work order. It is used to correct or expand a remark after it has been logged.

decoys.name: replywonote
decoys.desc: This tool posts a reply, with an optional title, under an existing note on a lift maintenance work order. It is used when a supervisor answers a remark logged by the crew.

decoys.name: closewonote
decoys.desc: This tool closes out an existing note on a lift maintenance work order with resolution text and an optional title. It is used once the problem a remark raised has been fixed.

decoys.name: signwonote
decoys.desc: This tool countersigns an existing note on a lift maintenance work order with the supervisor's comment and an optional title. It is used to confirm a crew remark before the lift reopens.

delete_note.name: killwonote
delete_note.desc: This tool permanently removes a note from a lift maintenance work order. The note is erased from the resort's system for good.

decoys.name: redactwonote
decoys.desc: This tool permanently redacts the text of a note on a lift maintenance work order. The wording is blacked out in the resort's system for good.

decoys.name: stripwonote
decoys.desc: This tool permanently strips the photos from a note on a lift maintenance work order. The images are erased from the resort's system for good.

decoys.name: hidewonote
decoys.desc: This tool permanently hides a note on a lift maintenance work order from contractors. The note is withheld from their portal for good.

set_image.name: setwoimage
set_image.desc: This tool sets the cover image shown on a lift maintenance work order record. It is typically the picture a supervisor chooses to identify the job.

decoys.name: setwodiagram
decoys.desc: This tool sets the tower diagram shown on a lift maintenance work order record. It is typically the manufacturer's drawing of the affected tower.

decoys.name: setwocert
decoys.desc: This tool sets the inspection certificate scan shown on a lift maintenance work order record. It is typically the signed state tramway certificate.

decoys.name: setwoschematic
decoys.desc: This tool sets the wiring schematic shown on a lift maintenance work order record. It is typically the control panel drawing for that lift.

writer.name: writetext
writer.desc: This tool writes a short message from a brief, which states what to say in the requester's own words, and the work orders it should mention. It returns the finished text.

decoys.name: writereport
decoys.desc: This tool writes an incident report from a brief, which states what happened in the supervisor's own words, and the work orders it should cover. It returns the finished report.

decoys.name: writescope
decoys.desc: This tool writes a scope of work from a brief, which states the job in the planner's own words, and the work orders it should include. It returns the finished scope.

decoys.name: writebulletin
decoys.desc: This tool writes a guest lift bulletin from a brief, which states the news in the marketing team's own words, and the work orders it should mention. It returns the finished bulletin.

image.name: renderimage
image.desc: This tool generates an image from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the result.

decoys.name: renderdiagram
decoys.desc: This tool generates a tower diagram from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the drawing.

decoys.name: rendersign
decoys.desc: This tool generates a lift closure sign from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the sign.

decoys.name: renderbadge
decoys.desc: This tool generates a crew id badge from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the badge.

search.name: searchdocs
search.desc: This tool searches the help docs and knowledge base with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up how the maintenance system works.

decoys.name: searchmanuals
decoys.desc: This tool searches the lift manufacturers' manuals with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up a torque value or part number.

decoys.name: searchcode
decoys.desc: This tool searches the tramway safety code with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to check what the state regulator requires.

decoys.name: searchlogs
decoys.desc: This tool searches the past ropeway logs with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to see how a fault was handled before.
